name: engineering-tools
description: Developer workflows for change assessment, code simplification, commits, technical debt, technical writing, and documentation sync.

interface.shortDescription: Size work, simplify code, and improve engineering workflows.
interface.longDescription: Assess software-change complexity, simplify code during implementation or review, audit technical debt, prepare Conventional Commits, and write clear technical documentation that stays in sync with the code.
defaultPrompt: Assess this software change's implementation complexity and recommend the next step.
Simplify this code or review it for unnecessary complexity while preserving behavior.
Audit this codebase for actionable technical debt.
Prepare a Conventional Commit from the staged changes.
Write or review this technical document, or check that our docs still match the code.
